## Summary

Describe the problem, approach, and user-visible changes. Link the related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm run check`
- [ ] `pnpm run build-npad` (required for runtime/packaging changes)
- [ ] `pnpm run test-npad-app` (requires the built app)
- [ ] Regression coverage and relevant documentation updated
- [ ] Licenses/notices preserved; no credentials or private data added

List actual commands/results and explain checks not run. Include screenshots for
visible UI changes when useful. Note dependency, security, and scope changes.
